status: TEST_ONLY / LOCAL_TEST_ONLY / NOT_QUALIFIED. Wire frames copied or derived from the Java sources named in each entry; never deployable values.

frames.name: auth
frames.source: signaling-protocol ProtocolContractTest.invalidUtf8Frames (valid frame); same shape as LocalRuntimeCompositionIT.Wss AUTH and loadgen VirtualClient.authenticate

frames.name: invite
frames.source: signaling-protocol ProtocolContractTest.frame("INVITE", {"targetUserId":"bob"}); same shape as LocalRuntimeCompositionIT invite literal and loadgen ScenarioRunner.invite

frames.name: accept
frames.source: loadgen ScenarioRunner.frame RINGING -> send("ACCEPT", null, null, {}) via sendForCall; ProtocolValidator default branch (empty payload, callId required)

frames.name: negotiate
frames.source: loadgen ScenarioRunner.frame CALL_READY -> NEGOTIATE_REQUEST {"iceRestart":false}; ProtocolValidator NEGOTIATE_REQUEST branch

frames.name: offer
frames.source: signaling-protocol ProtocolContractTest.preservesFullCounterPrecisionAndRejectsNumericWireCounters frame("OFFER", {"sdp":"v=0"}) (counters are decimal strings; numeric counters are rejected)

frames.name: answer
frames.source: derived from the OFFER frame: ProtocolValidator validates OFFER and ANSWER in one branch (case OFFER, ANSWER -> {sdp})

frames.name: hangup
frames.source: signaling-protocol ProtocolContractTest.derivesCallScopeFromImmutableRoutedCallId frame("HANGUP", {}) without the optional negotiationId/iceGeneration, which native-client command() and loadgen ScenarioRunner HANGUP never send

frames.name: event-received
frames.source: loadgen ScenarioRunner.ackEvent (EVENT_RECEIVED {eventId} with callId); ProtocolValidator EVENT_RECEIVED branch
